V1.scale: Measured ~133 bytes allocated per XML element (consistent across 10K–320K elements) with ~4.3 MB baseline. Extrapolating: with 1 GB heap and ~200 MB JVM/JQF overhead, ~6.2 million elements exhaust the remaining ~820 MB. That is ~25 MB of decompressed XML (6.2M × 4 bytes per <a/>). With measured deflate ratio ~1000:1 at large sizes, this needs ~25 KB of compressed input, well within the 65 KB limit.
